 MHA Transfers Two IAS Officers from J&K to Ladakh
 Rakesh Minhas, Faz Lul Haseeb shifted with immediate effect under AGMUT cadre reshuffle
 by 
 Observer News Service 
 November 7, 2026 
 Faz Lul Haseeb and Rakesh Minhas 
 Srinagar- The Ministry of Home Affairs has ordered the transfer of two IAS officers from Jammu and Kashmir to Ladakh with immediate effect.
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 As per an order issued by the Ministry, Rakesh Minhas, a 2016-batch IAS officer, and Faz Lul Haseeb, a 2018-batch IAS officer, have been transferred to Ladakh from Jammu and Kashmir.
 The transfers have been ordered with the approval of the competent authority and will remain in force until further orders, the order stated.
